runtime_lock.status: experimental; full GRPO replacement acceptance incomplete

scope: Twelve one-update arms on the same random tiny KDA/latent MoE global batch: EP1/EP2 x policy/auxiliary/combined x activation checkpointing off/on. Captured routes are replayed in all arms. Torch attention; no serving.

notes: Master parameter comparisons measure state agreement, not relative update agreement.
Superposition divides residual L2 by policy L2 + auxiliary L2 to remain stable near cancellation.
Nonzero first moments reject disconnected native policy or auxiliary router gradients.

limitations: Native Core consistency, not a matched Megatron comparison or independent full-objective reference.
One fixed synthetic global batch and one optimizer step; no learning-quality, full-SFT, restart or endurance claim.
Master-state relative error does not measure relative parameter-update error; first and second optimizer moments are compared separately.
Replay IDs come from a native Core forward; separate live SGLang replay evidence covers the serving connection.
BF16 comparisons permit 0.05 relative L2 error; observed errors and category sizes are retained, not just pass/fail.
The comparator does not explicitly compare replicated optimizer states on every rank; rank zero reconstructs the native state.
Expert master parameters differ by up to 0.0001626592 across topologies. Aggregate moment agreement does not establish exact Adam update agreement near zero gradients.
